findings.observation: The cheek mole, heart-shaped face, heavy level brow, small upturned nose, lower lip, and wrapped-side hair keep Eiro recognizable, but the face and hands shift to a warmer, materially lighter medium-deep brown than the summon-v2’s unmistakable very-deep ebony band 6; the large rounded eyes and softened cheek planes also read younger and more doll-like than the mature 29-year-old source.

The source’s tall conditioned-athletic construction is replaced by a noticeably stockier compact torso and wider mass distribution; the width increase exceeds proportion-only chibi shortening and weakens Eiro’s tall athletic source language.
Both forearms and clenched hands are visibly thicker and blockier than Eiro’s source-relative arm, wrist, and hand construction, producing the generic chibi inflation the target explicitly forbids.
Brown-chestnut color, asymmetric medium-loose front sweep, side part, gathered side mass, and purple-wrapped side section remain highly faithful and readable.

The plum-gray short mantle, unarmored tunic, divided lower layers, offset closures, reinforced cuffs, belt construction, travel tally cord, and contrasting plum boot laces are retained without added anchors.

The complete head-and-hair unit occupies approximately 34–35 percent of standing figure height, giving a clearly oversized adult head and a figure within the required 2.75–3.1-head range rather than a tall miniature.
Exactly one full-body subject appears with complete head and hair, both empty hands, both boots, tally cord, and all garment edges safely inside generous margins.
The grounded three-quarter ready-idle silhouette, separated empty hands, compact stance, bold mantle, and high-contrast boot laces remain clear at combat-icon scale.
The presentation stays grounded and mortal with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
